textures.oak-v1.png: Production game material: seamless tiling albedo texture of aged dark oak planks in an abandoned rural Spanish village, original 2005 survival horror environment realism. Square 1024x1024 orthographic face-on, fills canvas edge to edge. About 5 long vertical wide boards. Weathered grey brown timber, splintered fine grain, shallow cracks, subtle nail heads near plank edges, irregular wood knots, naturally bleached rough patches. Medium-low contrast with clearly legible material grain, no perspective, no border, no letters, no shadows cast by outside objects, no baked directional lighting, no furniture or background. Entire surface on one plane. Muted neutral warm gray-brown, not orange. Tile seamlessly in both directions.
textures.roof-v1.png: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless tileable game albedo texture. Perfect orthographic top-down face-on material scan of weathered old Spanish terracotta barrel roof tiles. Square 1024x1024 full frame. 6 columns and 6 overlapping staggered rows of small reddish-brown curved clay tiles; varied charcoal and desaturated burnt umber tones, lichen speckles and dusty pale edges, chipped corners, subtle cracks. Flat neutral diffuse lighting, no large cast shadows, no specular glare. Repeat seamlessly at all four edges. Texture only, no building, no sky, no border, no letters or watermark. Highly detailed believable ceramic surface for a PS2-survival-horror village roof; avoid cartoon drawing and avoid clean new bright orange tiles.
textures.plaster-v1.png: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: tileable game albedo texture. Square 1024x1024 face-on scan of old weathered lime plaster on a rural Spanish house. Entire canvas is material, seamless on all edges. Warm grey ivory mineral plaster with irregular fine hairline cracks, scuffed and flaking patches, darker grey-green damp mottling, granular aged lime, tiny exposed sandy aggregates, delicate ochre water stains. No large bricks or holes; plaster still covers the wall. Neutral soft even diffuse lighting, no perspective, no cast shadows, no ambient vignette, no objects, no text, no border. Detailed realistic material for gloomy original 2005 survival-horror village houses. Desaturated natural variation, restrained contrast, avoid bright pure white and avoid an abstract marble pattern.
